title.narrative: Advancing Justice for Syrians in Turkey

description.narrative: Overall objective: Support and strengthen civil society leaders and legal defenders in Turkey to protect the human rights of Syrian refugees through the promotion of access to justice, due process rights and non-discrimination. Specific objectives: 1. Enhance the right to a fair trial and due process protections for Syrian refugees. 2. Increase the capacity of legal defenders and civil society leaders to protect Syrian refugees from torture, ill-treatment, arbitrary detention, refoulement and other human rights violations. 3. Promote awareness among Syrian refugees of their rights under Turkish and international human rights law. 4. Increase collaboration among legal defenders, civil society and justice sector officials to implement due process and access to justice policy reforms for Syrian refugees.
